$comment: Every use of overrideAccess: true in src/ must be listed here with a justification. tests/int/override-access.int.spec.ts fails the build otherwise.

allowed.reason: Seed script; system operation run by an engineer, never reachable from a request.
Credential rotation for seeded test users; engineer-run system operation, never reachable from a request.
Background job: runs without a user. Tenant scope is enforced by the job's own where clause on input.tenantId; proven by tests/int/isolation-extended.int.spec.ts.
Engineer-run onboarding/import script, never reachable from a request. Every read and write names the tenant from the onboarding file.
Release pipeline, run by the publishSite job or after the endpoint has checked the caller's access to the site. Every query filters on the explicit tenantId; proven by tests/int/releases.int.spec.ts.
Builds a release snapshot for (tenantId, siteId) given by the pipeline; every query filters on that tenant. Proven by tests/int/releases.int.spec.ts.

Public renderer lookup (raw SQL through the pool, the same trust as overrideAccess): returns only the immutable snapshot of the release a site points at, and refuses a release whose tenant differs from the site's. Published sites are public by nature.
Engineer-run timing script (Gate 2 evidence); looks up one site by slug and hands its tenant to the pipeline. Never reachable from a request.
Engineer-run onboarding script that writes a hotel's site content; never reachable from a request. Every write names the tenant from the content file.

Public contact-form endpoint: reads the one form the visitor submits to and stores the submission under that form's tenant, after bot checks. Visitors are anonymous, so no user-scoped access applies; the tenant can only be the form's.
Engineer-run script that creates a hotel's owner account (owner role, that one tenant); never reachable from a request. Refuses super-admins and users of other tenants.
Engineer-run onboarding script that copies a hotel's photos into media; never reachable from a request. Every read and write names the tenant from the content file.
Hotel pack's release-snapshot contribution, called only by the release pipeline with an explicit tenantId; the query filters on it.

In-product ingest, run after src/ingest/endpoints.ts has checked the caller's access to the site or crawl with the caller's own access; every query filters on the explicit tenantId (jobs pattern). Proven by tests/int/ingest.int.spec.ts.
Fact upsert used by the ingest pipeline and the engineer-run import; every query filters on the tenantId the caller resolved.

Generation, run after src/generate/endpoints.ts has checked the caller's access to the site with the caller's own access; every query filters on the explicit tenantId and it writes drafts only. Proven by tests/int/generate.int.spec.ts.

Translation, run after src/generate/endpoints.ts has checked the caller's access to the site; every query filters on the explicit tenantId, writes drafts, never overwrites a person's text. Proven by tests/int/generate.int.spec.ts.

Brand proposal and apply, run after src/design/brand-endpoints.ts has checked the caller's access to the site; every query filters on the explicit tenantId; apply runs the same contrast gates as a hand-picked brand.
